assertions.name: no_documented_ck_satisfies_bar_even_law
assertions.source: c₂=-1, c₃=-2-ℏ², c₃=J_Hopf all violate the law

description: Prunes open-axis criterion 2(b) for the Q_β fibre kernel. b(q)=(q-q⁻¹)/(q+q⁻¹) is bar-ODD, so u=b·ℏ_q² is bar-odd-covariant (u→-q²u). The documented c₂=-1 and both c₃ candidates (-2-ℏ², J_Hopf) all VIOLATE the bar-even-kernel law c_k(q⁻¹)=(-1)^k q^(-2k)c_k(q). So criterion 2(b) cannot be imposed on the c_k ladder in u; the bar-symmetry lives in the full Q_β (bar-odd sinh partner). Constraint/pruning, not a value-hunt; nothing wired.
caveats: Pruning/constraint result for the gated fibre-kernel axis (qkhc) — NOT a real-q closed-form value-hunt (which is forbidden) and NOT a refuted mechanism. Sharpens/corrects open-axis criterion 2(b). The c_k vs the cos(α_eff)/Q_A factors of the full ladder may share bar-parity bookkeeping; this probe isolates the Π(1+c_k u^k) factor. Nothing wired.
